Is eight weeks really enough, and can this hurt me?
Eight weeks is a pretty common length for an elimination protocol — long enough to clear most food reactions from your system and run a meaningful number of reintroduction trials. That said, the specifics of your timeline were set up with your situation in mind, so it's not a one-size-fits-all number.

As for whether it can hurt you — a short-term elimination of a small number of foods is generally considered low-risk for most people. But I'm not the right source for a real answer to that question. If you have genuine concerns about whether the protocol is safe for you personally, that's worth bringing to your own doctor, who knows your full health picture. You can also reach the Sensify support team through the Support page in the app if you have questions about how the program itself is designed.
